packaging_correction: An initial diagnostic replay omitted the 727-byte LR scaler required by the original cell auditor and produced control false positives. That run was stopped; the scaler was added to the bounded baseline subset, and the full fresh replay reported here passed without changing detector logic.
limits: Comparison covers all declared case IDs and scientific decision fields listed in compare_replay.py.
RDF byte serialization, blank-node labels, timestamps, paths, and timing are not compared.
Direct scientific dependencies are pinned; the file is not a complete transitive environment lock.
Stored predictions and preprocessing artifacts are audited; models are not trained or used for inference.
SHACL establishes conformance to declared shapes, not semantic correctness or general fault-detection recall.
